component.name: LinuxPad++
component.summary: Source code editor, the native Linux edition of Notepad++

description.p: LinuxPad++ is Notepad++ with a native Qt interface for Linux: syntax highlighting, document tabs, split view, search and replace, macros and sessions.
More than 50 Notepad++ plugins are ported and bundled, among them ComparePlus, XML Tools, DSpellCheck, NppExec, Explorer, HEX-Editor, JSON Viewer and JSONTools.
